findings.title: Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Pre-Release Announcement - November 2026
findings.summary_md: Oracle dated this pre-release announcement 12 November 2026 in its page metadata, ahead of a Critical Security Patch Update scheduled for 17 November 2026. The notice says the update contains 652 new security patches, including 11 for Oracle Java SE that are all remotely exploitable without authentication, with a highest CVSS v3.1 base score of 8.1 for Java SE. It lists affected Java SE versions 8u511, 11.0.33, 17.0.21, 21.0.13, 25.0.5 and 27.0.1 and warns the information may change before the final advisory. The page does not name CVE-2026-114938 or describe a remote code execution flaw.

findings.title: watchTowr Intel on X: public reports of unauthenticated RCE in Java, CVE-2026-114938
findings.summary_md: watchTowr Intel posted on 17 November 2026 at 10:22 UTC that it was aware of public reports of an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Java, tracked as CVE-2026-114938 and said to affect OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later. The post says the details remain unconfirmed and advises organizations to review their Java environments and monitor vendor announcements. It names no exploit code, vulnerable component, fix, or observed exploitation.
